newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Old Mutual S.Africa takes over Syfrets unit.
newsitem.headline: Old Mutual S.Africa takes over Syfrets unit.

text.p: South Africa's biggest investment group Old Mutual said on Monday it had bought Syfrets Bank Ltd's stake in Old Mutual Syfrets Trust Ltd (OMST) for an undisclosed sum.
"Old Mutual Trust Ltd, as the company is to be called, will allow us to...offer an appropriate mix of specialist skills under one roof," Old Mutual general manager Bobbie Jooste said in a statement.
The new group would offer services ranging from tax and estate planning, to trust and estate administration, financial planning and investment and portfolio management.

OMST was set up as a joint venture in 1982 to enable Old Mutual clients, as part of their financial and estate planning, to have their wills drawn up and their estates and trusts professionally administered.
